contract.purpose: Store and retrieve project-scoped salience-gated memory for MAGRA sessions.
contract.scope: Implement SNARC-compatible SQLite-backed local schema, scoring, capture, search, context, patterns, identity facts, confidence decay, and stats.

invariants.invariant-1: Memory is local-first, project-scoped, and primarily stored in `.magra/snarc/memory.sqlite`.
invariants.invariant-2: Injected memories label provenance as observed, inferred, or identity.
invariants.invariant-3: Secrets and private prompt content respect Reasonix redaction settings.
